messages:
maya: Hey team — opened a docs PR for function-calling + structured output. Needs quick review before we merge: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 :wave:
kevin: looking now. main ask — the JSON Schema example for a list-of-results looks malformed. you have `items: {type: object}` but not `properties` inside. can paste a minimal fix? :eyes:
sajal: also can we add a short parsing pattern section? lots of users trip on how to parse mixed scalar/object responses. a tiny ts/python snippet would help.
maya: good catch, kevin — will update. Sajal, yes — I can sketch two snippets. thinking of showing: 1) validate via schema + 2) defensive parse with try/catch and a fallback to parsing line-delimited JSON.
oli: I can add a TypeScript SDK snippet that shows `client.parseStructuredResponse(...)` (pseudo). Should we also document the `invalid_schema` guardrail behaviour (what we do when model returns invalid JSON)?
marta: definitely document guardrails — mention our fallback policy: if structured output fails validation, we retry once with a hint then fallback to free-text and surface a warning in the console/traces. add the CLI debug command for repro.
ryan: tiny UX ask: in the examples page, can we link the schema to the playground templates? users expect to copy-paste. also add a migration note for SDK v1 -> v2 method name changes (parseStructuredResponse -> structured.parse).
doc-lint-bot: broken link detected: /docs/api/structured-output -> should be /docs/guides/structured-output (HTTP 404).
kevin: thanks bot. Maya — can you also include an example that shows array-of-objects + optional fields? real-world prompts often omit keys. e.g. schema that allows `address` to be null or object: "address": {"oneOf": [{"type":"object"}, {"type":"null"}]}
sajal: for parsing patterns, propose three snippets: 1) strict validation (throws), 2) forgiving parse (logs and continues), 3) heuristic extractor (regex + JSON.parse fallback). short and copyable.
maya: I'll push a follow-up commit in a bit. plan: update schema example, add TS + Python SDK snippets, add guardrails paragraph, fix links, and add migration note. assigning tasks: @oli TS snippet, @sajal write python snippet + parsing patterns, @kevin quick proofread on schema. sound ok?
oli: on it. I’ll PR a small snippet file under examples/structured-output/typescript.md and link it.
marta: also add a note for ops: how to set the structured-output strictness via console toggle (per-route). small screenshot would be great but we can do that in a follow-up if timebox.
ryan: I can add the playground template and a short test prompt. Share the JSON schema I can wire to the template.
kevin: pushed a tiny patch to the branch with corrected schema and an extra example that allows nullable fields. PTAL.
maya: saw it, thanks. doc-lint-bot also flagged a lint rule about sentence-case in headings — I'll fix headings in the PR.
doc-lint-bot: lint warning: heading 'structured output examples' -> use sentence case: 'Structured output examples'.
sajal: once merged, let's open follow-up issue to add instrumentation example showing how to capture validation failures in traces/alerts. customers keep asking about observability.
maya: good call. I'll create ISSUE-324 for that. merging after one more pass from @kevin. anyone else?
oli: thumbs up from me.
marta: +1
kevin: LGTM pending one small wording nit. will do quick commit or approve after.
maya: thanks all — will merge when kevin approves. :tada:
